title: Community 311 Templates Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Community 311 civic reporting templates, categories, and destinations.

emailSubjectTemplate.description: Site-wide default email subject template supporting {category} and {location} variables.

emailTemplate.description: Site-wide default email body template supporting {appTitle}, {category}, {department}, {location}, {mapsUrl}, and {answers} placeholders.

categories.description: List of report categories available for citizen selection.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for URL permalinks and template overrides.

name.description: Display name of the category shown in the list.

description.description: Short explanation of what issues fall under this category.

icon.description: Font Awesome icon name/classes or an <i>, layered HTML, or SVG snippet. Font Awesome classes, safe inline style properties, and data-fa attributes are retained. Pro glyphs require a licensed Pro stylesheet or kit.

destinations.description: Contact methods for dispatching citizen reports to this department.

email.description: Target email address for email dispatch, or null if unmonitored.

phone.description: Phone number for voice dispatch or immediate emergency calls.

webformUrl.description: Official municipal portal or webform URL.

socialUrl.description: Department social media or informational page URL.

address.description: Physical office address for in-person reporting or office visits.

emergency.description: Emergency detection settings for acute safety hazards.

enabled.description: If true, immediately triggers emergency alert regardless of questionnaire answers.

phone.description: Optional phone number used for acute emergency calls instead of the routine department phone.

keywords.description: Keywords or phrases in questionnaire answers that trigger acute emergency warnings.

emailSubjectTemplate.description: Optional category-specific override for the email subject line.

emailTemplate.description: Optional category-specific override for the email body text.

jurisdiction.description: Optional references to boundary features that include or exclude this category by report location.

includes.description: Boundary feature IDs that define allowed service areas. Multiple areas are combined.

excludes.description: Boundary feature IDs that explicitly exclude locations, overriding included areas.

questions.description: Follow-up questions presented to the citizen when this category is selected.

id.description: Unique identifier within the category's questionnaire.

label.description: Prompt or question text shown to the user.

required.description: Whether an answer must be provided before reporting.

placeholder.description: Helper hint text for text or textarea inputs.
